title: The Girl Who Stepped on Bread (The Stone of Inger)
summary: Stepping upon the loaf of bread to protect her morocco leather shoes, Inger sank into the slimy bogs of the underworld, frozen into a statue of pride....
keywords: the girl who stepped on bread
full_text:
Stepping upon the loaf of bread to protect her morocco leather shoes, Inger sank into the slimy bogs of the underworld, frozen into a statue of pride.

Centuries of suffering passed until the prayer of a child who wept for her soul penetrated the dark abyss. Inger wept tears of genuine repentance, was transformed into a humble sparrow, and flew across the snowy fields feeding hungry birds until her debt was forgiven and her spirit flew to God.
moral: Contempt for the staff of life drags the soul into the mire, but tears of remorse bring redemption.
